correctness.rationale: For exactly three GC bases the Watson–Crick reverse-complement involution has only size-two orbits. Exhaustive definitional enumeration gives 1280 balanced words, 640 orbits, 248 individually cross-bifix-compatible orbits, and 9048 pairwise compatibility edges. Each eligible code is exactly a graph clique doubled in size. CHECK.py uses a complete bitset branch search with valid greedy coloring bounds, visits 15560 nodes, and establishes clique number 22. WITNESS.txt contains 44 distinct words meeting all constraints. No finite test is extrapolated beyond the six-mer domain.

value.rationale: Exact capacity of a natural intersection of three DNA storage/synchronization constraints gives a benchmark not implied by individual constraints. The stand-alone finite optimum 44 quantifies a substantial capacity penalty compared to the known 192 GC-balanced non-overlapping six-mers without strand closure. No general-length theorem or physical primer performance is asserted.
